roster: Independent seeded proposals, with each accepted prefix compared with the archived sampler. Each possible pair meets with probability 1/3 and its multiplicity is uniform on {1,2} when present. Loose counts are uniform on {0,1,2}. Accept when connected with at least three places per knot and at most eighteen distinctions. One vote per accepted labelled sample with replacement, pooling equal numbers of samples by start size.
choice weighting: One per labelled choice at each positive-round closure in each mode.
